# Vanilla AMOLED Color

Vanilla AMOLED Color is a true-black variant for ultra-dark AMOLED displays that preserves the clean vanilla Obsidian look. It differs from a plain black theme by giving each heading level a distinct colour to mark visual hierarchy.

![Vanilla AMOLED Color screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sskki-exe/vanilla-amoled-theme-color/HEAD/sample-screenshot-sm.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Vanilla AMOLED Color"
    author: "sskki-exe"
    repo:   "sskki-exe/vanilla-amoled-theme-color"
    slug:   "vanilla-amoled-color"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/vanilla-amoled-color"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/sskki-exe/vanilla-amoled-theme-color"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sskki-exe/vanilla-amoled-theme-color/HEAD/sample-screenshot-sm.png"

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "Apply a true-black AMOLED theme for ultra-dark Obsidian displays. Preserve a clean vanilla look while adding colorful, distinct heading colors for clear visual hierarchy."
}
```
